sources.entry: 3. Go-SCP / Go programming language secure coding practices guide

summary.one_liner: A free OWASP-hosted book teaching secure web application coding practices in the Go programming language, organized around the OWASP Secure Coding Practices checklist.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a guide for developers using Go for web development, adapted from the OWASP Secure Coding Practices Quick Reference Guide v2. It covers the OWASP checklist topic by topic, with examples and recommendations for writing Go code that avoids common security mistakes. It explains what security problems can arise during development and how to handle them. The stated audience is developers with experience in other languages, and readers who have finished the Go tour. The book was originally created by the Checkmarx Security Research Team and later donated to the OWASP Foundation. The README links to PDF, Mobi, and ePub downloads of the book.
use_cases: review Go web app security practices
reference OWASP secure coding checklist for Go
onboard developers new to Go security
read a free security book for Go web development
how_to_run: Download the book from the README links: dist/go-webapp-scp.pdf, dist/go-webapp-scp.mobi, or dist/go-webapp-scp.epub
notable: Follows the OWASP Secure Coding Practices Quick Reference Guide v2 topic by topic
Hands-on approach with Go code examples for each security topic
Originally created by Checkmarx Security Research Team, later donated to OWASP
Available as PDF, Mobi, and ePub
caveats: The README does not describe any code or runnable project; it is a written guide
Primarily aimed at developers; the README does not state coverage of non-web Go use cases
